title: Derived tensor products preserve direct sums
statement:
For $A\in D(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$, each of the functors
$A\kunotimes{\Lambda}-$ and $-\kunotimes{\Lambda}A$ preserves
set-indexed direct sums.

proof.text: Apply the closedness of the derived monoidal category [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal-closed] to sheaves of Λ-modules on the small étale site, in the existing fixed universe convention. Its specialization is already packaged by AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.derivedTensorHomAdjunction in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Hom. Thus derivedTensor.obj A has a right adjoint. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits] to obtain preservation of every discrete coproduct shape, including the empty shape.

The canonical natural symmetry of the derived tensor identifies the right tensor functor with the left tensor functor. Preservation of colimits transfers across this natural isomorphism, so the flipped functor preserves every discrete coproduct as well.

proof_origin.place: Existing derived tensor--Hom adjunction and left-adjoint preservation, followed by the canonical derived tensor symmetry.
